knownRefusals.$comment: Ratchet for GLUE-6: golden fixtures a validator refuses TODAY. A listed fixture that fails is reported as KNOWN-FAIL and does not fail CI; a listed fixture that now passes FAILS CI until it is removed here. Only shrink this list. Each entry has `match`: the text dbt's refusal must still contain; a fixture refused for any OTHER reason FAILS.

metrics-semantic-layer.reason: dbt 1.9 refuses the generated semantic layer. First error: metric `sales__draft_signups__revenue` lacks the required `label`. Behind it (found by GLUE-6 on 2026-11-20 with labels added): measures carry `config` (not allowed in 1.9), COUNT measure `orders` has no `expr`, `orders` is both an entity and a measure, and semantic model / metric names contain dunders (`sales__orders`). Generator fix: WP-20.
